errors.evidence: The description claims the intervals on the x-axis are evenly spaced, but the years shown (2003, 2004, 2005, 2008, 2010, etc.) have varying time gaps between them.
The description states the color for Eastern Europe is red ('червено'), but the chart legend and bars clearly show it is yellow.
The values for Northern Europe range from a minimum of 3 (in 2010) to a maximum of 10 (in 2020), not from 2 to 8.
The lowest value for Northern Europe is 3 in 2010. The value in 2003 is 5.
The highest value for Northern Europe is 10 in 2020. The value in 2018 is 9.
The values for Western Europe range from a minimum of 2 (in 2003 and 2010) to a maximum of 8 (in 2012 and 2020), not from 1 to 9.
The values for Southern Europe range from a minimum of 0 (e.g., in 2003) to a maximum of 7 (in 2020), not from 0 to 6.
The highest value for Southern Europe is 7 in 2020. The value in 2018 is 6.
